content.title: Trump’s Potential Fed Chair Pick: How It Could Impact Interest Rates and ETFs
content.summary: President Trump's recent comments regarding the Federal Reserve leadership have created uncertainty. Although Fed Chair Jerome Powell's term lasts until May 2026, Trump's criticism and potential nominee speculations caused market volatility. A new Fed chair aligned with Trump's views might compromise the Fed's independence. Markets anticipate faster rate cuts under a new chair. This outlook could benefit bond and fixed-income ETFs in the short term.
